note: Robotics-degree availability and mechanical-engineering robotics-track data compiled Aug 2026 from each school's official catalog and departmental pages. Every value has an inline source. Analyst judgment on 'ME easier than CS' is documented per school.

mit.ecs_robotics_alt: Course 2-A is the flexible 'MechE + another field' degree; CIR (informally '2-A/6') is the robotics/controls pairing with EECS. MIT has no secondary major admission — students choose any course after first year.
mit.robotics_easier_than_cs_reason: MIT admits to the Institute without major declaration — students declare later; ME vs CS competitiveness is comparable.
mit.university_admit_differential_reason: "When you're admitted to MIT as a first-year student, you're admitted to the entire Institute" — applicants are not asked to decide on a major.
mit.internal_gate_differential_reason: "We don't ask you to decide on a major until you've had a chance to explore… Most MIT students declare a major in the spring of their first year," with no departmental admission step.
mit.admission_strategy: Robotics/ME framing changes nothing at MIT — one Institute-wide bar, and Course 2 vs Course 6 is a free spring-of-first-year declaration.
mit.early_admit_lift_reason: EA 6.0% vs Regular Action 3.5% = 1.71×. EA is nonbinding/non-restrictive.
mit.oos_gap_reason: Private — no residency preference. MIT admissions stats do not publish by state.
mit.nc_applicant_note: No advantage or disadvantage from NC residency.
mit.robotics_ecosystem_reason: CSAIL + LIDS + MechE robotics; 93% UROP participation is the most institutionalized undergrad research culture in the US.
mit.mechatronics_summary: No formal mechatronics degree — but Course 2 has 2.75 Precision Machine Design, 2.12 Robotics, and Course 2-A/6 (Mechanical + EECS) allows deep mechatronics customization. Same MIT admissions bar.

carnegie-mellon.ecs_robotics_alt: BS Robotics launched Fall 2023 in the Robotics Institute (SCS); internal transfer needs 3.6 QPA across six courses plus 3.0 overall. Important: the Robotics MINOR is open to any major OUTSIDE SCS and is the transcript-bearing option for non-SCS students; the parallel Robotics Concentration is SCS-only.
carnegie-mellon.robotics_easier_than_cs_reason: SCS Robotics BS requires 3.6 QPA for internal transfer; SCS admissions are equally selective as CS.
carnegie-mellon.university_admit_differential_reason: SCS admitted 350 of 6,756 ("under 5.2 percent") vs "19 percent acceptance rate for CMU's other seven undergraduate programs." TRAP: robotics is an SCS major, so "robotics" routes you into the hardest college — apply ME in CoE instead.
carnegie-mellon.internal_gate_differential_reason: Internal transfer into SCS requires ~3.6 QPA across six courses + 3.0 overall + space; changing programs inside CoE only requires good standing + C in intro engineering.
carnegie-mellon.admission_strategy: The COLLEGE you apply to is the whole game: CoE ME is a ~19% pool vs SCS's ~5%. But CMU's Robotics BS lives in SCS — apply "ME in CoE," not "robotics."
carnegie-mellon.early_admit_lift_reason: ED 20.6% vs derived RD 10.3% = 2.0×. Prior year gap was smaller — figure is volatile.
carnegie-mellon.oos_gap_reason: Private — no residency preference. CDS C7 leaves state residency blank; F1 residency table blank.
carnegie-mellon.nc_applicant_note: No advantage or disadvantage from NC residency.
carnegie-mellon.robotics_ecosystem_reason: 57 robotics labs/groups on one directory + 1,106-person Robotics Institute — deepest documented footprint in the set.
carnegie-mellon.undergrad_research_program: SURG, SURA, SURF, ISURF via CMU Undergrad Research Office
carnegie-mellon.mechatronics_summary: No formal mechatronics offering — mechatronics work happens inside the ME (Course 24) or ECE curriculum via electives.

penn.me_robotics_track_name: MEAM BSE 'Dynamics, Controls, and Robotics' track
penn.ecs_robotics_alt: GRASP Lab (Vijay Kumar) is a top-tier US robotics lab. The MEAM robotics concentration is declared on a concentration form after matriculation (default 'General'), effective for Fall 2020 entrants and later — no GPA gate.
penn.robotics_easier_than_cs_reason: Penn Engineering admits by school not major; MEAM is meaningfully less competitive than CIS/CS at the undergraduate level.
penn.university_admit_differential_reason: "You don't technically apply to Penn, you apply to one of our four undergraduate schools." Within SEAS the intended major does reach the committee, but no CIS-vs-MEAM admit rates are published.
penn.internal_gate_differential_reason: Declaring or changing an engineering major is a form + two advisor meetings; CIS and MEAM are not limited-enrollment. Only Digital Media Design and NETS are restricted.
penn.admission_strategy: SEAS with MEAM as intended major is the one lever Penn gives you — SEAS is the only school that asks intended major — but no differential is published.
penn.early_admit_lift_reason: Penn has ED but stopped publishing round-level rates. 51% of enrolled class was admitted ED.
penn.oos_gap_reason: Private — no residency preference. 82% of Class of 2029 from out of state.
penn.nc_applicant_note: No advantage or disadvantage from NC residency.
penn.robotics_ecosystem_reason: GRASP Lab (General Robotics, Automation, Sensing & Perception) is famous — ~25 faculty, 15+ labs; Kod*Lab, HAL, ModLab.
penn.undergrad_research_program: CURF — Center for Undergraduate Research & Fellowships
penn.mechatronics_summary: Mechatronics concentration was archived; MEAM's replacement is Dynamics, Controls & Robotics — same admissions bar as ME.

cornell.me_robotics_track_name: Robotics Minor (administered through MAE) — 6 courses / 18+ credits
cornell.ecs_robotics_alt: Robotics Minor is 3 Fundamentals + 3 in one specialization (Intelligence, Modeling-Dynamics-Control, Perception, or Systems & Design). Open to all undergrads EXCEPT those already doing the ECE, ME or CS minors. ME BS itself names robotics as an 'area of concentration.'
cornell.robotics_easier_than_cs_reason: MAE is direct-admit within Cornell Engineering; CS is a highly-gated major after admission.
cornell.university_admit_differential_reason: "You do not apply to a particular major; you apply to the college" — ME and Engineering-CS applicants face one Engineering bar (6.6% admit rate).
cornell.internal_gate_differential_reason: CS affiliation requires a supplemental application + ≥2.5 GPA in CS 2110/2112+CS 2800/2802 + ≥2.3 math GPA; ME affiliation needs only C-/C grades and >2.5 across four courses, no supplemental.
cornell.admission_strategy: "ME on your Cornell Engineering app" buys you nothing at admission, but a lot at affiliation time: no supplemental CS application, just a plain course-GPA screen.
cornell.oos_gap_reason: Private with 4 NY statutory colleges (CALS/HumEc/ILR/CoE-adjacent). NY 13.3% vs OOS 9.0% university-wide; NY edge is in statutory colleges (CoE is endowed).
cornell.nc_applicant_note: NC applicants get no edge, but CoE is fully endowed so residency does not hurt for engineering.
cornell.robotics_ecosystem_reason: CS Robotics Group + Autonomous Systems Lab + Verified Robotics Lab; ~8-10 labs, no dedicated robotics institute.
cornell.undergrad_research_program: Nexus Scholars, Rawlings Presidential Research, URF
cornell.mechatronics_summary: No formal mechatronics track or minor at Cornell; mechatronics is elective-cluster within ME.

purdue.ecs_robotics_alt: BS Robotics is engineering-technology (Polytechnic), not College of Engineering; a second Robotics Engineering Technology program was announced for Purdue Indianapolis in 2025. Purdue ME's undergrad page names no concentrations, tracks, or robotics minor at all.
purdue.robotics_easier_than_cs_reason: Polytechnic admissions are meaningfully less competitive than CS.
purdue.university_admit_differential_reason: Purdue admits to First-Year Engineering, then competes for major. Polytechnic Robotics Engineering Technology BS is a separate lower-selectivity admission — no rates published for that program.
purdue.internal_gate_differential_reason: 93-95% get first-choice engineering major after FYE; CS CODO is space-restricted with published GPA requirement.
purdue.admission_strategy: Enter First-Year Engineering and transition to ME (93-95% get first choice); CS CODO is space-restricted.
purdue.early_admit_lift_reason: EA offered; EA applications published (63,883/86,953 for Fall 2025) but no EA admit count.
purdue.nc_applicant_note: NC applicant in the 39% OOS pool — near-half the in-state rate.
purdue.robotics_ecosystem_reason: Purdue Robotics Accelerator + IRAS Center; ~12-15 robotics labs across ECE/ME/AAE/IE. Not a top-tier robotics institute but broad depth.
purdue.mechatronics_bs_name: Mechatronics Engineering Technology BS (Purdue Polytechnic Institute, ETAC/ABET-accredited)
purdue.mechatronics_summary: Materially easier admit than Purdue College of Engineering ME: Polytechnic Institute admits at 54.2% (GPA 3.48-3.98) vs CoE 46.1% (GPA 3.81-4.00). TRADE-OFF: Polytechnic degrees are ETAC/ABET-accredited (Engineering Technology), not EAC/ABET (traditional engineering) — this can matter for PE licensure and some grad school admissions.

penn-state.ecs_robotics_alt: Penn State launched a BS and minor in Artificial Intelligence Engineering at University Park. No ME robotics track; ME 454 Mechatronics is a required prescribed course (C or better) and ME 456 Introduction to Robotics is an elective. The Mechatronics Minor is at Penn State Harrisburg, NOT University Park.
penn-state.robotics_easier_than_cs_reason: ME entrance-to-major is less GPA-gated than CS at PSU.
penn-state.university_admit_differential_reason: Entrance-to-Major (ETM) process at University Park applies to all engineering. No CS-vs-ME admit differential published.
penn-state.internal_gate_differential_reason: ETM GPA is identical at 3.20 for CS and ME at University Park.
penn-state.admission_strategy: ETM GPA is identical at 3.20 for CS and ME at University Park — no differential either way.
penn-state.early_admit_lift_reason: EA offered (moved to Nov 15); no C22 split published.
penn-state.oos_gap_reason: PA residents 60%+ of undergrads; overall 55.3% admit rate suggests weaker OOS emphasis but explicit split not published.
penn-state.nc_applicant_note: NC applicant treated as OOS; PSU accepts OOS but at lower rate.
penn-state.robotics_ecosystem_reason: Robotics & Autonomous Systems Group + ARL; ~8-12 labs. Applied Research Lab is defense-focused.
penn-state.mechatronics_bs_name: Electro-Mechanical Engineering Technology (EMET) BS — 130 credits, ETAC/ABET-accredited, delivered at Commonwealth campuses (e.g. Beaver, not University Park)
penn-state.mechatronics_summary: EMET is Penn State's mechatronics-alias degree — but it's an ENGINEERING TECHNOLOGY degree (ETAC/ABET, not EAC/ABET like traditional engineering) and delivered at Commonwealth campuses, not University Park. Different accreditation path from CS/ME. Mechatronics Minor also exists at Penn State Harrisburg.

rit.bs_robotics_name: Robotics and Manufacturing Engineering Technology BS
rit.me_robotics_track_name: Mechanical Engineering Technology BS — Robotics and Automation Option
rit.ecs_robotics_alt: ME BS options are Aerospace, Automotive, Bioengineering, Energy & Environment — no robotics. Robotics lives in the College of Engineering Technology (RMET/MET), plus an open-add-on Robotics and Automation Minor.
rit.robotics_easier_than_cs_reason: Engineering Technology admissions are meaningfully less competitive than CS/SE at RIT.
rit.university_admit_differential_reason: CET (Robotics/Manufacturing Eng Tech): GPA 91-96 / SAT 1300-1460 / ACT 28-34, only 3 yrs HS math. Golisano computing: GPA 93-97 / SAT 1370-1510 / ACT 31-35, 4 yrs math preferred.
rit.internal_gate_differential_reason: RIT's admission policy and degree-modification pages returned no usable text on internal transfer gates.
rit.admission_strategy: Apply CET Robotics/Manufacturing Eng Tech — measurably softer admit stats than Golisano CS (91-96 GPA vs 93-97, 1300-1460 SAT vs 1370-1510).
rit.early_admit_lift_reason: ED 73.2% vs derived non-ED 71.0% = 1.03× — near-zero rate advantage; ED valuable for scholarships/housing only.
rit.best_early_deadline: ED I Nov 1 / EA Nov 1 / ED II Jan 1
rit.oos_gap_reason: Private — no residency preference; 71.1% overall admit rate; state split not published.
rit.nc_applicant_note: No advantage or disadvantage from NC residency.
rit.robotics_ecosystem_reason: Multi-Agent Bio-Robotics Lab + others; ~5-8 labs. Strong industry pipeline via co-op.
rit.mechatronics_bs_name: Mechatronics Engineering Technology BS (Mechanical & Mechatronics Engineering Technology Dept, College of Engineering Technology)
rit.mechatronics_summary: RIT's Mechatronics Engineering Technology BS is in the College of Engineering TECHNOLOGY (CET) — same college as RIT's Robotics ET path. CET has published lower stats than Golisano CS (GPA 91-96 vs 93-97; SAT 1300-1460 vs 1370-1510), so this is likely EASIER than KGCOE ME but not directly published. ETAC/ABET-accredited.

me_robotics_courses: MMAE 539 Robot Localization and Motion Planning
illinois-tech.ecs_robotics_alt: MMAE specializations (fluids, thermal, solids, dynamics-and-controls, CAD/manufacturing) do not name robotics, but MMAE 443/446 Introduction to Robotics IS an undergraduate course. ECE runs an 'Artificial Intelligence, Robotics and Automation' track (ECE 438/441/442/447/449/481/497).
illinois-tech.robotics_easier_than_cs_reason: Illinois Tech's ECE Robotics track is less selectively demanded than CS.
illinois-tech.university_admit_differential_reason: "each major has its own criteria for admission," but Illinois Tech's selectivity language groups engineering and computing together — only Architecture, Biology, Chemistry, Physics are singled out as selective.
illinois-tech.internal_gate_differential_reason: Change of Major form; "Approval from the intended major department is required." No GPA threshold, prerequisite, or capacity limit published.
illinois-tech.admission_strategy: Per-major criteria exist but engineering and computing are grouped in Illinois Tech's own selectivity language — no clear differential.
illinois-tech.early_admit_lift_reason: ED 68.1% vs derived RD 55.3% = 1.23×. ED pool is tiny (69 apps).
illinois-tech.oos_gap_reason: Private urban — no residency preference. IL 60.7% vs OOS 61.6% (2023-24).
illinois-tech.nc_applicant_note: No advantage or disadvantage from NC residency.
illinois-tech.robotics_ecosystem_reason: Institute of Design + Robotics Lab in ECE; small but present. Chicago location gives industry access.
illinois-tech.mechatronics_summary: Electromechanical Systems minor exists; no dedicated BS or ME track. Same admissions as ME.

wpi.ecs_robotics_alt: First dedicated undergraduate Robotics degree in the US (2007); 374 majors as of 2025
wpi.robotics_easier_than_cs_reason: RBE and CS are both direct-admit at WPI, but RBE is meaningfully less oversubscribed than CS.
wpi.university_admit_differential_reason: NOT direct-admit to major — "You will be prompted to declare your major near the end of B-Term of your first year." One Common Application for all first-year students.
wpi.internal_gate_differential_reason: No GPA threshold or capacity gate published; change of major handled in Workday. RBE page invites: "Undecided? No problem."
wpi.admission_strategy: WPI is NOT direct-admit — you declare near the end of B-Term in year one. No admit-time or declaration differential between CS and RBE.
wpi.best_early_deadline: ED I Nov 1 / EA Nov 1 / ED II Jan 5
wpi.oos_gap_reason: Private — no residency preference. MA 65.6% vs OOS 65.5% (essentially identical).
wpi.nc_applicant_note: No advantage or disadvantage from NC residency.
wpi.robotics_ecosystem_reason: Dedicated Robotics Engineering DEPARTMENT with 15 labs + 12 research clusters + largest RBE-degree student body in US. Tier-1-like for undergrad research access despite smaller absolute size.
wpi.undergrad_research_program: MQP (Major Qualifying Project) — every senior does a research/industry project
wpi.mechatronics_summary: WPI's Robotics Engineering BS is inherently mechatronics — no separate mechatronics degree needed. RBE = ME + ECE + CS integrated.

me_robotics_courses: Interdisciplinary: mechanical design + electronics + computing + AI (specific course numbers not published)
rpi.ecs_robotics_alt: Joint ECSE + MANE degree, so the ME-side robotics path IS the joint degree. Caution: RPI's own page notes 'robotics courses consistently fill to capacity.'
rpi.robotics_easier_than_cs_reason: Both direct-admit; RPI CS and Robotics have similar admission competitiveness.
rpi.university_admit_differential_reason: Applicant chooses a major or applies "Undeclared to a specific school (i.e., undeclared engineering)." No major-level admit rate published.
rpi.internal_gate_differential_reason: "Undergraduate students typically declare a major by the end of their first year"; no GPA threshold published.
rpi.admission_strategy: Holistic engineering admission; joint ECSE+MANE Robotics degree is same admit bar as CS. Watch out: "robotics courses at RPI consistently fill to capacity."
rpi.early_admit_lift_reason: Offers ED I, EA, ED II, RD — but publishes no admit rates.
rpi.best_early_deadline: ED I Nov 1 / EA Dec 1 / ED II Jan 6
rpi.oos_gap_reason: Private — no residency preference. NY 67.5% vs OOS 68.5%.
rpi.nc_applicant_note: No advantage or disadvantage from NC residency.
rpi.robotics_ecosystem_reason: CATS Lab (Computational Autonomous Transportation) + several ECSE/MANE labs; ~8-10 robotics labs.
rpi.mechatronics_summary: No formal mechatronics offering at RPI; the joint MANE+ECSE Robotics degree covers the same ground.

georgia-tech.me_robotics_track_name: ME BS 'Automation and Robotic Systems' concentration — 15 cr, optional
georgia-tech.ecs_robotics_alt: ECE runs a Robotics and Autonomous Systems thread (ECE 3550 + ECE 4550 required) selectable by EE and CmpE majors. A Robotics minor exists but REQUIRES A SEPARATE APPLICATION. Note CmpE students on a CS thread are barred from the CS minor.
georgia-tech.robotics_easier_than_cs_reason: Georgia Tech CS is one of hardest engineering admits; ME is direct-admit and meaningfully less competitive.
georgia-tech.university_admit_differential_reason: College of Computing 8.5% vs College of Engineering 13.1% first-year admit rates (2024).
georgia-tech.internal_gate_differential_reason: CS is closed to change-of-major for Summer-2024+ matriculants; ME accepts change-of-major with a 2.5 GPA threshold.
georgia-tech.admission_strategy: Apply ME — CoC 8.5% vs CoE 13.1%, and CS is closed to change-of-major for Summer-2024+ matriculants.
georgia-tech.early_admit_lift_reason: EA2 rate 8.1% is BELOW overall 13.3% — early round has no rate advantage for OOS applicants.
georgia-tech.oos_gap_reason: GA 30% vs OOS 9% (Fall 2025); Fall 2026 GA 28% / OOS 9%. Ratio 0.30 — one of the largest OOS gaps in the country.
georgia-tech.nc_applicant_note: Structurally competitive for NC applicants: OOS 9%. Apply EA2 (non-GA round) but expect low base rate.
georgia-tech.robotics_ecosystem_reason: IRIM (Institute for Robotics & Intelligent Machines) with 90+ faculty and 20+ affiliated labs; Vertically Integrated Projects program.
georgia-tech.undergrad_research_program: UROP, Research Option, PURA, Vertically Integrated Projects
georgia-tech.mechatronics_summary: Mechatronics is a huge RESEARCH area at Georgia Tech but there is no formal undergrad mechatronics track — the closest is the ME Mechatronics course sequence.

uiuc.ecs_robotics_alt: Robotics is distributed across MechSE, ECE and Aerospace electives rather than packaged as a degree or track. Gate to know: MechSE enforces a 2.25 GPA on lower-level technical courses before upper-level ME/TAM courses.
uiuc.robotics_easier_than_cs_reason: Grainger CS is one of top-3 hardest CS admits in country; UIUC ME is meaningfully less competitive.
uiuc.university_admit_differential_reason: CS 7.4% admit rate vs Grainger Engineering 21.2% — Grainger CS is one of the hardest CS admits in the country.
uiuc.internal_gate_differential_reason: Both CS and ME are closed to on-campus major change at UIUC.
uiuc.admission_strategy: Apply ME — CS 7.4% vs Grainger 21.2%, but note both are closed to on-campus major change once enrolled.
uiuc.early_admit_lift_reason: Nonbinding EA offered; CDS C22 blank.
uiuc.oos_gap_reason: IL residents ~62% of undergrads; overall 36.6% Fall 2025. Grainger Engineering is much more competitive for OOS.
uiuc.nc_applicant_note: NC applicant in OOS pool at UIUC; Grainger CS is especially tough OOS.
uiuc.robotics_ecosystem_reason: CSL — Coordinated Science Lab + IRL + BRETL Lab; ~15+ robotics labs. Grainger is one of the largest engineering colleges.
uiuc.mechatronics_summary: No formal mechatronics track at Grainger; mechatronics happens through ME + ECE course selection.

michigan.ecs_robotics_alt: BSE Robotics is GATED at only 2.0 GPA after one term in CoE. Degrees awarded grew 2 (2023) -> 14 (2024) -> 40+ (2025), and five new concentrations were added to the undergraduate robotics major in 2026. Core: ROB 204 gateway + 3 of ROB 310/311/320/330/340 + EECS 280 + ROB 450 capstone.
michigan.robotics_easier_than_cs_reason: BSE Robotics 2.0 GPA gate is minimal; Michigan CS is much harder to get into.
michigan.university_admit_differential_reason: Michigan admits by CoE; no CS-vs-ME admit-rate differential published. CS enrollment restriction was REMOVED as of Spring 2026.
michigan.internal_gate_differential_reason: Robotics BSE, ME, and CS all declare at 2.0 GPA after one term in CoE.
michigan.admission_strategy: Get into CoE by any route; Robotics BSE, ME, and CS all declare at 2.0 GPA after one term.
michigan.early_admit_lift_reason: NEW binding ED (Nov 1, decision Dec 24) added since last CDS; no rates yet.
michigan.oos_gap_reason: MI residents ~45% of enrolled class despite being ~10% of applicants — strong in-state preference at U-M.
michigan.nc_applicant_note: NC applicant is in the OOS pool where OOS enrollment is capped functionally by preference.
michigan.robotics_ecosystem_reason: Michigan Robotics Institute (moved to standalone department 2022) in the Ford Robotics Building — 45+ faculty, 20+ labs.
michigan.mechatronics_summary: No formal mechatronics track. Michigan's dedicated Robotics BSE covers mechatronics territory.

johns-hopkins.ecs_robotics_alt: ME's only formally recognized tracks are Aerospace and Biomechanics — robotics is an informal depth area with no formalization process. The transcript-bearing option is the LCSR Robotics Minor: 18+ credits across three skill areas (kinematics/dynamics, systems/signals/control, computation/sensing) including 3+ lab credits.
johns-hopkins.robotics_easier_than_cs_reason: JHU CS is competitive; ME + LCSR robotics minor is a less-gated path.
johns-hopkins.university_admit_differential_reason: "When you applied to Hopkins, you applied to the full university, and not to a specific school or major (except biomedical engineering)… You are not bound to the major you listed on your application."
johns-hopkins.internal_gate_differential_reason: Change major within Whiting or into A&S by emailing advising; Undecided Engineering "will allow the student to transfer into any engineering department (except BME)."
johns-hopkins.admission_strategy: Hopkins gives no admissions edge for ME over CS — you're admitted to the university either way — only closed door post-admission is BME.
johns-hopkins.early_admit_lift_reason: ED I+II combined 10.9% vs derived RD 5.2% = 2.08×.
johns-hopkins.best_early_deadline: ED I Nov 1 / ED II Jan 3
johns-hopkins.oos_gap_reason: Private — no residency preference. MD 4.7% (199/4,233) vs OOS 7.0% (2,469/35,321); OOS actually higher.
johns-hopkins.nc_applicant_note: No residency edge — OOS applicants are actually admitted at slightly higher rates.
johns-hopkins.robotics_ecosystem_reason: LCSR (Laboratory for Computational Sensing & Robotics) is one of the largest US medical/surgical-robotics centers; 30+ affiliated faculty.
johns-hopkins.mechatronics_summary: No formal mechatronics offering. Robotics happens through LCSR + ME/ECE.

maryland.bs_robotics_name: BS in Mechatronics Engineering (Universities at Shady Grove)
maryland.me_robotics_track_name: Robotics and Autonomous Systems (RAS) Minor — 21-22 cr, launched Fall 2021
maryland.ecs_robotics_alt: RAS Minor is open to Aerospace, ECE, ME and CS majors with no separate application (C- or better required, max 2 courses double-count). Clark School also runs a BS in Mechatronics Engineering at Shady Grove from Fall 2024 (ENMT380 Intro to Robotics, ENMT372 Robotic Systems, ENMT450 Robotics Programming).
maryland.robotics_easier_than_cs_reason: UMD ME direct-admit is less competitive than CS (which is a Limited Enrollment Program).
maryland.university_admit_differential_reason: Both Engineering (all majors) and CS are LEPs. Applying to either faces the LEP process.
maryland.internal_gate_differential_reason: CS internal transfer competes for ~100 slots/yr; Engineering (incl. ME) has GPA-threshold review without a hard slot cap.
maryland.admission_strategy: Both CS and Engineering are LEPs, but CS transfer competes for ~100 slots/yr vs Engineering's GPA-threshold review.
maryland.early_admit_lift_reason: EA offered; CDS C22 blank — no EA-vs-RD split published.
maryland.oos_gap_reason: MD residents historically admitted at 2× the OOS rate; Fall 2024 CDS reports selectively but ~75% of enrolled undergrads are MD residents.
maryland.nc_applicant_note: NC applicant faces the tougher OOS pool. UMD is structurally competitive for NC — treat like an OOS flagship.
maryland.robotics_ecosystem_reason: Maryland Robotics Center (MRC) with 30+ faculty; Institute for Systems Research; robotics is a top-3 strength area.
maryland.undergrad_research_program: FIRE, Maryland Center for Undergraduate Research (MCUR)
maryland.mechatronics_bs_name: BS in Mechatronics Engineering (Universities at Shady Grove campus, launched Fall 2024, 121 credits)
maryland.mechatronics_summary: Full BS Mechatronics Engineering at UMD Shady Grove — SAME Clark School admissions criteria as ME per the program page. Curriculum has senior-year tracks in Robotics and Autonomous Air Vehicles — strong robotics prep. Note: taught at Shady Grove (Rockville MD), not College Park.

northeastern.ecs_robotics_alt: University-wide Robotics Minor (ECE-administered), open to all students; no dedicated BS
northeastern.robotics_easier_than_cs_reason: Minor is open university-wide; no ME-vs-CS differential documented.
northeastern.university_admit_differential_reason: "All applicants are considered for admission to all programs, and applicants will rank their top three program preferences," with no published program-level admit rates.
northeastern.internal_gate_differential_reason: Khoury requires 2.0 GPA + intro course; COE requires 2.0 GPA + C in math/chem/physics — near-identical thresholds.
northeastern.admission_strategy: Ranking 3 preferences hedges softly; both Khoury and COE gates are 2.0-GPA-plus-intro-course, symmetric on switching later.
northeastern.early_admit_lift_reason: ED 35.3% vs derived RD 4.0% = ~8.8× — widest gap in the set.
northeastern.best_early_deadline: ED I Nov 1 / ED II Jan 1
northeastern.oos_gap_reason: Private — no residency preference. MA 10.4% vs OOS 5.2% (skew reflects MA-heavy applicant pool, not policy).
northeastern.nc_applicant_note: No residency preference. NC applicant not disadvantaged; MA rate skew is applicant self-selection.
northeastern.robotics_ecosystem_reason: Institute for Experiential Robotics is dedicated but only ~5 documented labs; co-op is the differentiator, not research density.
northeastern.mechatronics_bs_name: Mechatronics, BS (Lowell Institute School, College of Professional Studies) — DEGREE-COMPLETION route, not first-year admission
northeastern.mechatronics_summary: Northeastern DOES have a Mechatronics BS — but it's in the Lowell Institute School (College of Professional Studies) and is a DEGREE-COMPLETION program, not a freshman-application route. Not usable as a high-school-senior admissions strategy.

ohio-state.ecs_robotics_alt: Robotics and Autonomous Systems Minor (12 cr, no application needed)
ohio-state.robotics_easier_than_cs_reason: OSU ME and CS are BOTH Limited Space Programs with pre-major lock-in — you cannot switch into either.
ohio-state.university_admit_differential_reason: Must name pre-major on the Common App. Both CS and ME are Limited Space Programs.
ohio-state.internal_gate_differential_reason: CS and ME are both Limited Space Programs with identical 2.0 floors and space-competitive transitions.
ohio-state.admission_strategy: Must name the pre-major on the Common App; CS and ME are both LSPs with identical 2.0 floors.
ohio-state.oos_gap_reason: OH residents ~68% of class; OOS ~30% of class. In-state significantly higher admit rate.
ohio-state.nc_applicant_note: NC applicant in OOS pool; less competitive than in-state but OSU actively recruits nationally.
ohio-state.robotics_ecosystem_reason: Center for Automotive Research + Robotics & Human Intelligence Lab; ~10-15 robotics-adjacent labs.
ohio-state.mechatronics_summary: No formal mechatronics offering at OSU; mechatronics research happens in Center for Automotive Research + ECE labs.

nc-state.ecs_robotics_alt: EE BS Controls & Robotics Concentration; joint NCSU/UNCA Engineering BS Mechatronics
nc-state.robotics_easier_than_cs_reason: All engineering first-years enter as EFY; CODA (Change of Degree Application) ranks all majors by GPA equally.
nc-state.university_admit_differential_reason: All engineering first-years enter as EFY; CS and ME compete equally under CODA.
nc-state.internal_gate_differential_reason: CS and ME both go through ranked CODA against per-department seat caps.
nc-state.admission_strategy: Everyone is Engineering First-Year; CS and ME both go through ranked CODA against per-department seat caps.
nc-state.early_admit_lift_reason: EA offered; CDS C22 blank — no split published.
nc-state.oos_gap_reason: NC residents 46.2% (11,157/24,141) vs OOS 34.4% (7,508/21,852). UNC System caps OOS at 18% of class by state law.
nc-state.nc_applicant_note: MAJOR ADVANTAGE for NC applicant. NC State is structurally your friendliest engineering flagship.
nc-state.robotics_ecosystem_reason: Center for Robotics & Intelligent Machines (CRIM) + Robotics Group; ~10 labs across ME/ECE/CS.
nc-state.undergrad_research_program: OUR Federal Work-Study Research; independent study
nc-state.mechatronics_bs_name: BS in Engineering — Mechatronics Concentration (Joint NC State / UNC Asheville program, ABET EAC-accredited, taught on UNC Asheville campus)
nc-state.mechatronics_summary: Full BS mechatronics through the Joint NC State/UNC Asheville Engineering program (JEM) — site-based joint degree taught at UNC Asheville. Different physical location from Raleigh CoE; admissions bar not published separately. Curriculum is MAE + ECE hybrid, strong robotics prep.

unc-chapel-hill.ecs_robotics_alt: NO ME department at UNC; Applied Sciences BS (Environmental/Materials), BME, AI minor available
unc-chapel-hill.robotics_easier_than_cs_reason: UNC has no mechanical engineering path.
unc-chapel-hill.university_admit_differential_reason: UNC has no mechanical engineering path.
unc-chapel-hill.internal_gate_differential_reason: No ME path; CS itself is gated by a spring application after COMP 210.
unc-chapel-hill.admission_strategy: Not a robotics route — no ME department, and CS requires admission to the major after COMP 210.
unc-chapel-hill.early_admit_lift_reason: EA 23.1% vs derived post-EA rate 10.2% = 2.26× (Fall 2023). For NC residents applying EA, decisions arrive Dec 20 vs Feb 10 for OOS.
unc-chapel-hill.oos_gap_reason: NC residents 37.0% (6,605/17,846) vs OOS 9.6% (4,685/48,645). State law caps OOS at 18% of each entering class.
unc-chapel-hill.nc_applicant_note: MAJOR ADVANTAGE for NC applicant — the strictest OOS cap in the US works in your favor.
unc-chapel-hill.robotics_ecosystem_reason: CS Robotics Lab + haptics research; ~4-6 labs. No dedicated engineering — smaller CS-only robotics footprint.
unc-chapel-hill.mechatronics_summary: UNC-CH has no ME department, so mechatronics is not applicable here.

virginia-tech.me_robotics_track_name: Robotics and Mechatronics (RBMT) major within the BSME
virginia-tech.ecs_robotics_alt: RBMT is a first-in-US ME-housed robotics major; ~100 students/year cohort; GATED entry within ME
virginia-tech.robotics_easier_than_cs_reason: Robotics degree is an ME-internal election; you don't need a CS seat.
virginia-tech.university_admit_differential_reason: All engineering first-years enter General Engineering with one bar.
virginia-tech.internal_gate_differential_reason: ME is a *restricted* major at VT; CS is not restricted.
virginia-tech.admission_strategy: All engineering first-years enter General Engineering; ME is a restricted major while CS is not — CS is actually EASIER internally.
virginia-tech.early_admit_lift_reason: Nonbinding EA offered; CDS C22 blank.
virginia-tech.oos_gap_reason: VA residents ~65% of undergrads; overall 54.6% Fall 2025.
virginia-tech.nc_applicant_note: NC applicant in OOS pool at VT; VT is southeastern reciprocity-adjacent but no formal NC preference.
virginia-tech.robotics_ecosystem_reason: Center for Autonomy & Intelligent Robotics (CAIR) + ~10 labs across ECE/ME. TerraSentia autonomy work.
virginia-tech.mechatronics_summary: MAJOR CHANGE: VT's Robotics and Mechatronics major inside ME is DISCONTINUED — "Students can no longer declare Robotics and Mechatronics within Mechanical Engineering as of January 2026." Enrolled students who can't graduate by May 2027 move to plain ME. Do NOT apply expecting this major.

florida.ecs_robotics_alt: UF ME lists robotics as 'specialized interest' but no formal track; no robotics minor in MAE
florida.robotics_easier_than_cs_reason: No documented differential admission between UF ME and CS.
florida.university_admit_differential_reason: UF direct-admit into major; no CS-vs-ME admit differential published.
florida.internal_gate_differential_reason: CS critical tracking is 2.5 GPA over 6 courses; ME's is 2.8 GPA over 8 courses — ME is the tighter one at UF.
florida.admission_strategy: CS is actually the easier path at UF — CS critical tracking is 2.5 GPA vs ME's 2.8.
florida.early_admit_lift_reason: UF binding ED added for Fall 2027 (Oct 15 deadline); EA/RD rates not split.
florida.oos_gap_reason: FL 22.3% (9,387/42,172) vs OOS 20.5% (8,086/39,420) = 0.92 ratio. Admit rates near identical — the gap is in cost (Bright Futures), not access.
florida.nc_applicant_note: NC applicant faces near-identical admit odds to a FL applicant; sticker price is the real gap.
florida.robotics_ecosystem_reason: UF Center for Intelligent Machines and Robotics (CIMAR) + 10-15 robotics labs across MAE/ECE/CISE.
florida.undergrad_research_program: University Scholars, Emerging Scholars, SUIRP, URSP
florida.mechatronics_summary: No formal mechatronics program; UF has a Robotics MS and mechatronics research but no undergrad track.

olin.me_robotics_track_name: Engineering: Robotics concentration (E:Robo) — under general Engineering degree
olin.ecs_robotics_alt: Concentrations may be self-designed with advisor + 2 faculty signatures
olin.robotics_easier_than_cs_reason: Olin admits to college with no CS degree — path comparison doesn't apply.
olin.university_admit_differential_reason: Olin offers only three ABET degrees (ECE, ME, Engineering) — no CS major to compare against. Single holistic pool + required Candidates' Weekend.
olin.internal_gate_differential_reason: Engineering-degree students "work with a faculty advisor to choose courses" for a concentration and may design their own, no separate admission.
olin.admission_strategy: One applicant pool, one interview-based second round — no CS major exists, so nothing to game.
olin.early_admit_lift_reason: Olin has NO early plan — publishes 'the reason you can't apply early.'
olin.oos_gap_reason: Private — no residency preference. MA 14.3% vs OOS 26.2% (2023-24); OOS higher (Olin recruits nationally).
olin.nc_applicant_note: No advantage or disadvantage from NC residency; MA applicants actually lower rate.
olin.robotics_ecosystem_reason: Two robotics labs at a 378-student college; depth comes from projects and industry capstones, not research infrastructure.
olin.undergrad_research_program: Every student does a Senior Capstone Program in Engineering (SCOPE) — industry-sponsored
olin.coop_pipeline: No formal co-op; SCOPE = industry projects
olin.mechatronics_summary: Olin's BS in Engineering is inherently mechatronics-flavored (ME + ECE + Robotics blend by design); no separate track needed. Same admissions.

rose-hulman.ecs_robotics_alt: 'At Rose-Hulman, we do not offer a major in robotics' — minor only; IGVC/MATE-ROV competition teams
rose-hulman.robotics_easier_than_cs_reason: Minor is open equally to ME/EE/CompE/SE/CS majors.
rose-hulman.university_admit_differential_reason: Rose-Hulman "continue[s] to embrace a holistic admission process" with a single set of HS course expectations, no major-specific criteria published.
rose-hulman.internal_gate_differential_reason: "A student wishing to change curriculum… should notify the Registrar's office as soon as possible," with no GPA or capacity condition.
rose-hulman.admission_strategy: No published CS-vs-ME admit differential; changing major is a registrar notification — low-stakes choice on both sides.
rose-hulman.early_admit_lift_reason: EA offered but CDS C22 blank; no ED plan.
rose-hulman.oos_gap_reason: Private — no residency preference. IN 72.1% vs OOS 85.1% (OOS higher).
rose-hulman.nc_applicant_note: No residency disadvantage; OOS applicants actually admitted at higher rates.
rose-hulman.robotics_ecosystem_reason: Robotics at Rose-Hulman is competition-team and coursework driven — facilities page lists no robotics research lab.
rose-hulman.mechatronics_summary: No formal mechatronics track at Rose-Hulman; mechatronics content is via ME + ECE electives.

carleton.ecs_robotics_alt: NO engineering department at Carleton; Dual Degree 3-2/3-3/4-3 with Washington University available
carleton.university_admit_differential_reason: Carleton admits to the college; declaration form isn't available until sixth term. And Carleton has no ME/robotics major.
carleton.internal_gate_differential_reason: "Early in the sixth term of enrollment, but not before that term, students must declare an academic area as their major field," with no GPA or course prerequisites.
carleton.admission_strategy: One admissions bar, ungated sixth-term declaration; no engineering major means robotics/ME strategy doesn't apply.
carleton.early_admit_lift_reason: ED 36.6% vs derived RD 18.7% = 1.96× — just under LARGE threshold.
carleton.best_early_deadline: ED I Nov 15 / ED II Jan 15
carleton.oos_gap_reason: Private LAC — no residency preference. MN 34.7% (221/636) vs OOS 39.3% (1,127/2,870); OOS actually higher.
carleton.nc_applicant_note: No advantage or disadvantage from NC residency.
carleton.robotics_ecosystem_reason: Zero robotics research labs and no institute on any Carleton page; robotics is coursework/club-only.

swarthmore.ecs_robotics_alt: Single BS in Engineering (no specialized majors); Robotics Lab exists; ~40 majors/yr
swarthmore.robotics_easier_than_cs_reason: You don't apply for a major until second semester of sophomore year.
swarthmore.university_admit_differential_reason: Swarthmore admits to the college; "we don't even ask them to declare a major until Spring of their sophomore year."
swarthmore.internal_gate_differential_reason: CS has C+/C grade gate on CPSC 031/035 and a course lottery where non-majors are "not guaranteed"; Engineering has no numeric threshold, only Sophomore Plan approval.
swarthmore.admission_strategy: Same college-wide holistic bar, but CS has a real C+/C gate and course lottery that Engineering doesn't — Engineering route is modestly safer once enrolled.
swarthmore.best_early_deadline: ED I Nov 15 / ED II Jan 4
swarthmore.oos_gap_reason: Private LAC — no residency preference; national applicant pool.
swarthmore.nc_applicant_note: No advantage or disadvantage from NC residency.
swarthmore.robotics_ecosystem_reason: Small engineering dept with 2-3 robotics-adjacent labs; project- and course-driven.
swarthmore.mechatronics_summary: Swarthmore's BS Engineering is broad-based; mechatronics is elective-cluster within it.

uc-berkeley.ecs_robotics_alt: Berkeley ME has only Aerospace concentration; robotics via EECS C106A/B; ME robotics is research-only
uc-berkeley.robotics_easier_than_cs_reason: CS change-of-major requires 3.3 UC GPA; ME is direct-admit and much less competitive.
uc-berkeley.university_admit_differential_reason: Apply to specific program within CoE — EECS and ME are separate application targets. CoE first-year admit rate 6% vs campus 11%. Berkeley Engineering warns: "we receive far more applicants than we can admit."
uc-berkeley.internal_gate_differential_reason: EECS change-of-major: min 3.7 GPA in two of four gateway courses, must be first change, before 4th term; "highly unlikely for impacted majors." ME: UC GPA 3.3 in technical coursework.
uc-berkeley.admission_strategy: Apply directly to ME as your program target — EECS is separately-admitted and dramatically harder, and internal transfer to EECS requires 3.7 GPA ("highly unlikely") vs ME's 3.3.
uc-berkeley.early_admit_lift_reason: UC system: no ED/EA — one Nov 30 filing window.
uc-berkeley.oos_gap_reason: CA >12% vs domestic non-CA ~10% and international ~5%; UC policy structurally prioritizes CA residents; 68% of admits from CA.
uc-berkeley.nc_applicant_note: NC applicant faces ~10% base rate at Berkeley; structurally difficult for OOS.
uc-berkeley.robotics_ecosystem_reason: BAIR (Berkeley AI Research), AUTOLAB, Hybrid Systems Lab, Sky Lab + BiiG; 25+ robotics-focused labs.
uc-berkeley.coop_pipeline: No formal co-op; industry proximity substitutes
uc-berkeley.mechatronics_summary: Berkeley ME has a mechatronics elective cluster (Mechatronic Systems technical electives) but no formal track or minor. Same ME admissions.

uw-seattle.me_robotics_track_name: Mechatronics Option — B.S. ME with Option in Mechatronics
uw-seattle.ecs_robotics_alt: Direct-to-College guarantees access to the ME major, but the Mechatronics OPTION has an application process separate from ME admission, applied during ME 374 in junior spring. Allen School Direct-to-Major is the CS gate and you cannot be considered for direct admission twice.
uw-seattle.robotics_easier_than_cs_reason: Direct-to-College guarantees ME; Direct-to-Major CS is a specific hard gate.
uw-seattle.university_admit_differential_reason: Direct to Major CS/CE: 30% WA / 2% non-WA. Direct to College engineering: 43% WA / 37% non-WA. Allen School 2024-25: 8% of 8,048 applicants.
uw-seattle.internal_gate_differential_reason: "If you're not admitted directly to the Allen School as a first-year, it's unlikely that you'll be admitted to computer science." ENGRUD ME placement: 2.0 GPA across placement courses, guaranteed engineering placement if 6 majors ranked.
uw-seattle.admission_strategy: Apply Direct-to-College ME (37% OOS) instead of Direct-to-Major CS (2% OOS). Once admitted, DTC guarantees engineering placement; DTM-CS cannot be retried.
uw-seattle.early_admit_lift_reason: UW: no ED/EA — one Nov 15 deadline. Residency + Direct-to-College choice matter far more than timing.
uw-seattle.oos_gap_reason: WA 47% (3-yr avg) vs non-WA 39% (uni-wide). Direct-to-Major CS 37% WA / 5% non-WA — the CS gap is severe.
uw-seattle.nc_applicant_note: NC applicant is treated as OOS. Do NOT apply Direct-to-Major CS from NC (5% rate); apply Direct-to-College engineering (37% OOS).
uw-seattle.robotics_ecosystem_reason: UW Robotics + Personal Robotics Lab + RSE-Lab + WATRI; 15+ labs. Allen School AI is world-class.
uw-seattle.mechatronics_summary: UW ME has a formal Mechatronics Option (one of two BSME options), awarded as "BS ME with Option in Mechatronics". WATCH OUT: Option requires a junior-year competitive application in ME 374 — UW says capacity is "growing" and the selection process is "evolving." Not guaranteed even after ME admission.

ut-austin.bs_robotics_name: Texas Robotics Honors Program (honors overlay + Minor in Robotics)
ut-austin.ecs_robotics_alt: First-in-nation direct-admit-from-high-school robotics program; 500-word robotics essay by Dec 1
ut-austin.robotics_easier_than_cs_reason: ME is eligible for freshman robotics application; no CS seat needed.
ut-austin.university_admit_differential_reason: Direct-admit into major after holistic review. CS is CNS major w/ Calculus Readiness; ME is Cockrell. Robotics Honors Program allows direct-admit from HS via any of 6 majors including ME. Rates not published.
ut-austin.internal_gate_differential_reason: CNS internal transfer to CS: min 3.0 GPA, 24 in-residence hrs, competitive on space, max 2 attempts. Cockrell internal to ME: 3.0 GPA + essay, no fixed threshold.
ut-austin.admission_strategy: Direct-admit ME with intent to add Robotics Honors from HS (500-word essay by Dec 1). Internal transfer to CS is a 3.0-GPA-plus-space competition.
ut-austin.early_admit_lift_reason: Priority Oct 15 deadline; UT's CDS blocks direct file access. Top-6% Texas rule compresses timing effects.
ut-austin.oos_gap_reason: TX top-6% rule (auto-admit) drives majority of admits; ~10% of class is OOS; ratio around 0.21 (in-state to OOS).
ut-austin.nc_applicant_note: NC applicant faces very competitive OOS pool at UT-Austin; the top-6% rule crowds out OOS.
ut-austin.robotics_ecosystem_reason: Texas Robotics + LARG + AMRL + Nuclear Robotics Group; new Robotics Honors Program with direct-admit; 20+ labs.
ut-austin.undergrad_research_program: Faculty Research Mentor Program, Research Aide Program
ut-austin.mechatronics_summary: UT Austin ME has a formal Robotics & Mechatronics Career Gateway Elective (CGE) track (4 courses / 12 hrs) inside the BS ME — but it's an elective track, not a separate admit target. Same ME admissions bar.

duke.ecs_robotics_alt: Robotics & Automation Certificate (7 courses); IDEAS self-designed BSE major
duke.robotics_easier_than_cs_reason: Major declaration after freshman year with no GPA gate on either side.
duke.university_admit_differential_reason: Duke states plainly: "it is not easier or harder to be admitted to one program or another," and the application asks only for "preliminary academic interests."
duke.internal_gate_differential_reason: Trinity students declare during sophomore year with no GPA threshold and no capped or restricted majors — only consequence of not declaring is a registration block.
duke.admission_strategy: Trinity CS vs Pratt ME at Duke is a wash on both counts — same bar, no post-admission gate.
duke.oos_gap_reason: Private — no residency preference. 84% of first-years from out of state.
duke.nc_applicant_note: Duke is in NC but residency confers no admissions advantage. Being local may help for legacy/geographic-mission softly.
duke.robotics_ecosystem_reason: Bass Connections is strong for cross-disciplinary undergrad research; Duke Robotics has 4-6 labs (Pratt).
duke.mechatronics_summary: No formal mechatronics offering; mechatronics content is inside ME/ECE electives at Pratt.

texas-am.ecs_robotics_alt: MXET is ABET-ETAC not EAC; robotics certificate is GRADUATE-ONLY; all engineering starts in ETAM
texas-am.robotics_easier_than_cs_reason: MXET goes through Engineering Technology, less competitive than CSCE via ETAM.
texas-am.university_admit_differential_reason: Admitted to College of Engineering, not the major: "Undergraduate students are admitted to the Texas A&M University College of Engineering with a preference for the major noted."
texas-am.internal_gate_differential_reason: ETAM: same application pool for all majors. Same published minima (2.0 GPA + required courses w/ C). Placement is by capacity, which A&M doesn't publish per major.
texas-am.admission_strategy: MXET and CSCE compete in the SAME ETAM pool under identical published minima — no differential either way.
texas-am.early_admit_lift_reason: Priority Nov 1 review — no round rate published.
texas-am.oos_gap_reason: TX residents strongly favored; overall ~51.7% admit but in-state significantly higher (specific split not in CDS).
texas-am.nc_applicant_note: NC applicant in OOS pool at TAMU; treat as OOS engineering flagship.
texas-am.robotics_ecosystem_reason: 20 robotics labs across three engineering departments; CANVASS coordinating center but no unified faculty roster.
texas-am.mechatronics_bs_name: Multidisciplinary Engineering Technology BS — Mechatronics Track (MXET), Department of Engineering Technology and Industrial Distribution (ETID)
texas-am.mechatronics_summary: MXET Mechatronics is one of three focus areas in TAMU's Multidisciplinary Engineering Technology BS. All freshmen enter General Engineering, so admit rate is the same as any other CoE major — MXET vs CSCE compete in the same ETAM pool with identical minima. Advantage is CURRICULAR (mechatronics is closer to robotics than either ME or CS alone).

ut-dallas.ecs_robotics_alt: No robotics track anywhere; UTD is elective-only for robotics
ut-dallas.robotics_easier_than_cs_reason: UTD is direct-admit across engineering; ME and CS have similar competitiveness.
ut-dallas.university_admit_differential_reason: Direct admit to intended major; alternate-major offers when capacity binds. No major-level admit statistics published.
ut-dallas.internal_gate_differential_reason: Change of major via Undergraduate Online Change of Plan; Associate Dean evaluates academic record. Two free modifications, no major-specific gate published.
ut-dallas.admission_strategy: Direct-admit into intended major; UTD publishes no major-level rate differential.
ut-dallas.early_admit_lift_reason: No ED/EA; rolling to May 1 with Dec 1 priority for scholarships/honors.
ut-dallas.oos_gap_reason: TX residents preferred; overall 65.1% admit rate is high. TX-preferred but generous to OOS.
ut-dallas.nc_applicant_note: NC applicant slightly disadvantaged vs in-state but UTD admits generously OOS.
ut-dallas.robotics_ecosystem_reason: Three robotics labs, no institute; undergraduate lab access limited to three schools by application.
ut-dallas.mechatronics_summary: UTD's mechatronics concentration is graduate-only. Undergrad ME has mechatronics research through its Robotics Center but no formal track.

kettering.bs_robotics_name: BSE with Robotic Systems concentration (161 cr)
kettering.ecs_robotics_alt: ME has NO robotics or mechatronics concentration at Kettering; robotics is BSE-specific
kettering.robotics_easier_than_cs_reason: Direct-admit across all BSE concentrations; comparison doesn't apply cleanly.
kettering.university_admit_differential_reason: Robotic Systems is a concentration inside the BS in Engineering, not a separate admit target. Holistic, test-optional admission.
kettering.internal_gate_differential_reason: BSE students "select one of the following application areas" including Robotic Systems; no GPA threshold or capacity limit published.
kettering.admission_strategy: Robotic Systems is a concentration in BSE — apply to Kettering as usual, then select Robotic Systems track.
kettering.early_admit_lift_reason: No round-level admit rates published; EA + rolling.
kettering.oos_gap_reason: Private — no residency preference; 79% overall admit rate. No CDS residency data.
kettering.nc_applicant_note: No advantage or disadvantage from NC residency.
kettering.robotics_ecosystem_reason: Robotics is teaching-lab and competition-team centered; no faculty research roster published.
kettering.undergrad_research_program: None named — co-op serves this role
kettering.coop_pipeline: Yes — mandatory alternating co-op (Kettering is co-op-first university)
kettering.mechatronics_bs_name: BS in Engineering — Mechatronic Systems concentration (52-credit degree-titled concentration)
kettering.mechatronics_summary: Mechatronic Systems is a degree-titled concentration in Kettering's BS Engineering (siblings: Robotic Systems, Manufacturing Systems). Same admissions bar as ME; mechatronics curriculum is strong prep for robotics AND runs alongside mandatory co-op with automotive/robotics industry.

michigan-dearborn.ecs_robotics_alt: First dedicated undergrad Robotics BS in Michigan (2014, 8 yrs before Ann Arbor); DIRECT-admit at 3.0 HS GPA
michigan-dearborn.robotics_easier_than_cs_reason: 3.0 HS GPA = guaranteed admission to Robotics BSE; much less selective than Ann Arbor CS.
michigan-dearborn.university_admit_differential_reason: Direct admit into chosen CECS major. University-wide 3.0 HS GPA = Guaranteed Admission. No major-level differential.
michigan-dearborn.internal_gate_differential_reason: No CS declaration gate on fetched pages; no robotics declaration gate. 4+1 pathway requires 3.2 CGPA (grad, not declaration).
michigan-dearborn.admission_strategy: 3.0 HS GPA guarantees university admission — direct-admit Robotics BSE and CS have the same bar.
michigan-dearborn.early_admit_lift_reason: No early plans; rolling/priority — decisions from Oct 15.
michigan-dearborn.best_early_deadline: Rolling (apply Aug 1 for decisions from Oct 15)
michigan-dearborn.oos_gap_reason: Public MI regional — significant MI resident preference; ~90%+ of undergrads from MI.
michigan-dearborn.nc_applicant_note: NC applicant is unusual here — check whether Dearborn accepts OOS at competitive rate.
michigan-dearborn.robotics_ecosystem_reason: 10 robotics/automation teaching-and-research labs across three departments; AI center but no robotics center.
michigan-dearborn.coop_pipeline: Yes — co-op strong via Detroit industry proximity
michigan-dearborn.mechatronics_summary: 9-credit Mechatronics & Robotics undergraduate certificate stackable with BSE-ME; not a standalone degree. Michigan-Dearborn's dedicated Robotics BSE is the stronger route.
